# Eclipse Animator Wiki

> Fan wiki for Eclipse Animator, the Roblox Studio animation plugin by riftkuro and seven — claim it free before paid-only, install and setup, IK/FK and Blender rig import, Moon Animator comparison and tutorials.

Site: https://eclipseanimatorroblox.wiki

- Eclipse Animator: The Complete Guide — the full orientation: https://eclipseanimatorroblox.wiki/guide/eclipse-animator
- Eclipse Animator Roblox Plugin Guide — the plugin story: https://eclipseanimatorroblox.wiki/guide/eclipse-animator-roblox-plugin-guide
- How to Get It Free — the limited claim window: https://eclipseanimatorroblox.wiki/guide/how-to-get-eclipse-animator-free
- Install & Setup — from claim to first rig: https://eclipseanimatorroblox.wiki/guide/install-and-setup
- Beginner Tutorial — your first animation: https://eclipseanimatorroblox.wiki/guide/beginners-tutorial

## Features

- IK & Rigging — inverse kinematics, unparenting, live editing: https://eclipseanimatorroblox.wiki/features/ik-and-rigging

- vs Moon Animator — the comparison settled: https://eclipseanimatorroblox.wiki/comparisons/vs-moon-animator
